purpose: Teach: ありふれ/眠ら/怯え/おろそか/膨れ/太り/はいり/たたい

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんはありふれた日常が大切と思うのよ
lines.en: Sho — you know, Mei-sis thinks ordinary days are the most precious things we have.
lines.style: Gentle, reflective tone. Soft opening, like sharing something she's thought about carefully. Warm but unhurried. Eyes distant, not commanding attention.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、夜中眠らずにお父さんを待ってたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I stayed up all night waiting for Dad to come home.
lines.style: Quiet confession, slightly trembling underneath. The words tumble out carefully, like he's been holding them. Small voice, but sincere. No performance.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、嵐に怯えなくて大丈夫よ
lines.en: Sho — it's okay. You don't have to be afraid of the storm.
lines.style: Tender reassurance, steady and present. Soft attack, like placing a hand on his shoulder. Quiet conviction that carries safety. No rush.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お絵描きをおろそかにしないよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I won't forget to draw anymore. I promise.
lines.style: Small, earnest declaration. Sitting up straighter with determination. Careful pronunciation, like the promise matters. Genuine, not performed.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、おもちゃの風船を膨れさせるのお手伝いするわ
lines.en: Sho — let me help you blow up that balloon for your toy.
lines.style: Warm offer, eyes crinkling slightly. Generous and present. Opening with a small smile in the voice. Unhurried, inviting him into the moment.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんが少し太り気味かもって心配だよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I think Dad might be getting a little heavier. It worries me.
lines.style: Soft, perceptive observation. Not sarcastic—genuine worry wrapped in a child's careful words. Pause before 'heavier,' checking himself. Small, honest.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがお家にはいりやすいよう道を空けようね
lines.en: Sho — let's clear a path so Dad can get into the house more easily.
lines.style: Practical suggestion, kind and purposeful. Clear tone, like she's already thought this through. Slight warmth in 'let's'—including him in action.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと太鼓をたたいて遊んだよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad and I played drums together today. It was so fun.
lines.style: Bright, genuine joy breaking through. Quick opening, words tumbling out with real delight. No holding back. The warmth of a good memory just happened.
